title: 第十五章 包销合同第十六章 引气入体
content_zh:
“干嘛这样看我，你是不是还知道什么？”
顾文看着殷东的表情不对，有些不安的问。
这时候肯定不能说实话，殷东淡淡的说：“我是在看你有多蠢！
你竟然想把这种事情说给你妈听，是嫌她心脏太好，不会被你吓死是不是？再说了，你爸在外头的事情，她能知道多少？你让她去查，还不如直接找吴冬林问算了。”
“你给我留点面子，好不好？”
说着，顾文朝开车的王海生看了一眼，才想到刚才说的话都让王海生听到了。
殷东说：“海生不会露口风的。”
“说得好像我在怀疑海生一样。”
顾文有些尴尬的说，心思被人看穿的感觉真不好。
不过这人是殷东，他很快抛开这点不自然，又说：“除了我妈，那我最相信的就是铁山叔了，我下午去找他一趟，也许铁山叔会去找你求证。”
“我知道的也不多，都告诉你了。”
殷东说完，又转头对王海生说：“这件事情干系重大，我知道你的口风紧，但还是要提醒你在外留个心眼儿。
我没避着你说顾家的事，也是怕你中了别人的套儿，做出伤害文子的事。”
这番话除了是告诫王海生，也是在给顾文解释，为什么要在王海生面前说顾家的事。
这让两人都有点疑惑，王海生跟顾家八竿子打不着吧？
就听殷东又说：“你卖渔获也走远点，别总是守着镇里的码头，顾文家里有海产公司，你家的渔获通过顾文家卖出去，收购价比在镇上码头卖高不少。”
顾文顿时明白了，笑了笑。
王海生还没明白，挠着头说：“我以前试过去县里的海产公司联系，不过他们都有固定的供货商，不收零货，说是怕质量出问题。
我们白山镇的供货商就是固定的那几个，我们只能把渔获卖给他们，让他们赚差价。”
殷东说：“那是行业内的潜规则，海产公司采购部的人拿了供货商的回扣，当然要找个藉口拒收零货。

你让顾文回去打个招呼，以我们村的名义创个品牌，保证渔获都是野生的，上岸就直接送到县里，你看海产公司收不收！”
顾文立马表态：“这个没问题，我现在就打电话让采购部的人明天过来，跟你们村里签包销合同。”
说着，顾文推了推镜框，又笑道：“海产公司就是吴冬林在管，采购部更是他的自留地，我现在算是的动他一块奶酷，正好试一试他的反应。”
“他肯定全力配合你这顾氏太子爷，说不定还会对海生大力拉拢。
你不用让采购部的人来村里签合同，就让海生去县里签合同吧。”
殷东只想给王海生谋利，话语权肯定要掌握在王海生手里，而不是让村里直接插手进来。
顾文秒懂：“行啊，我跟采购部的人交待，在这里就只认海生了。”
“海生，还不给我们顾太子敬个酒。”
殷东笑着拍了王海生一巴掌，小宝也有样学样，一爪子拍过去。
“这绝对是亲儿子。”
顾文看得大乐，一把将小宝拎过来，抱在怀里，拿筷子沾了一点酒给小宝尝了一下。
content_en:
"Why are you looking at me like this? Do you know anything else?"
Gu Wen looked at Yin Dong's expression and asked uneasily.
He definitely couldn't tell the truth at this time, so Yin Dong said calmly: "I'm just looking at how stupid you are!
You actually want to tell your mother such a thing, is it because she has a good heart and won't be scared to death by you, right? Besides, how much does she know about your father's affairs outside? If you ask her to investigate, it's better to ask Wu Donglin directly. "
"Save some face for me, okay?"
As he said that, Gu Wen glanced at Wang Haisheng who was driving, and then realized that Wang Haisheng had heard what he just said.
Yin Dong said: "Haisheng won't reveal anything."
"It sounds like I'm doubting Hai Sheng."
Gu Wen said with some embarrassment, it felt really bad to have someone see through his mind.
But this person was Yin Dong. He quickly put aside this unnaturalness and said: "Apart from my mother, the one I trust most is Uncle Tieshan. I will go to him in the afternoon. Maybe Uncle Tieshan will go to you for confirmation."
"I don't know much, I've told you everything."
After Yin Dong finished speaking, he turned to Wang Haisheng and said: "This matter is of great importance. I know you are tight-lipped, but I still want to remind you to be careful outside.
I didn't avoid talking about the Gu family's affairs with you, because I was afraid that you would fall into someone else's trap and do something that would hurt Wenzi. "
In addition to admonishing Wang Haisheng, these words also explained to Gu Wen why he wanted to talk about the Gu family in front of Wang Haisheng.
This made both of them a little confused. Wang Haisheng and the Gu family are not at odds with each other, right?
Then Yin Dong said again: "You should go further to sell your catch. Don't always guard the dock in the town. Gu Wen's family has a seafood company. Your catch is sold through Gu Wen's family. The purchase price is much higher than selling it at the dock in town."
Gu Wen understood immediately and smiled.
Wang Haisheng still didn't understand, scratched his head and said: "I tried to contact the seafood company in the county before, but they all have fixed suppliers and do not accept loose goods, saying they are afraid of quality problems.
We only have a few suppliers in Baishan Town. We can only sell our catch to them and let them make the difference. "
Yin Dong said: "That is an unspoken rule in the industry. If people in the purchasing department of a seafood company take kickbacks from suppliers, of course they have to find an excuse to refuse to accept the spare parts.
You ask Gu Wen to go back and say hello, create a brand in the name of our village, ensure that the catch is all wild, and deliver it directly to the county when it is landed. You see whether the seafood company will accept it or not! "
Gu Wen immediately expressed his position: "This is no problem. I will call now to ask someone from the purchasing department to come over tomorrow and sign an underwriting contract with your village."
As he said that, Gu Wen pushed up the frame of the mirror and said with a smile: "Wu Donglin is in charge of the seafood company, and the purchasing department is his private area. Now I am touching him a little bit, just to test his reaction."
"He will definitely cooperate fully with you, the Crown Prince of the Gu family, and he might even try to win over Hai Sheng.
You don't need to ask people from the purchasing department to come to the village to sign the contract, just ask Haisheng to go to the county to sign the contract. "
Yin Dong only wanted to benefit Wang Haisheng, and the right to speak must be in Wang Haisheng's hands instead of letting the village directly intervene.
Gu Wen understood immediately: "Okay, I'll tell the people in the purchasing department that we only recognize Haisheng here."
"Hai Sheng, why don't you give our Prince Gu a toast?"
Yin Dong smiled and slapped Wang Haisheng, and Xiaobao followed suit and slapped him with his paw.
"This is definitely his biological son."
Gu Wen was so happy that he picked up Xiao Bao, held him in his arms, dipped his chopsticks in some wine and gave Xiao Bao a taste.
